Write a brief factual notice for residents saying the shared laundry room will be unavailable for a morning inspection and asking them to remove clothes beforehand. Write approximately 32–40 English tokens. Return only the text.

message.content: Please be advised that the shared laundry room will be temporarily unavailable tomorrow morning for a scheduled inspection. We kindly request all residents to remove any clothing or personal items from the machines before 8:00 AM to ensure smooth access for the maintenance team.
